The discussion focused on locating and understanding the functionality of the campaign list component. It was determined that the report screen does not recalculate metrics live; instead, it displays a previously saved report. The method for requesting a report calculation is via `POST /api/campaigns/report/screens` using all necessary parameters, which subsequently saves the data along with the campaign save action.

[me] successfully located the shared campaign list component within the common module of the campaigns feature.
decisions: Report screen displays saved reports rather than calculating metrics live.
